To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have derived the most general N=1 supersymmetric action in 3d coupled to matter, that we have shown that it agrees with the action obtained by compactifying 11d on a Spin( 7) holonomy space and taking into account non-vanishing 4-form fluxes, and that the scalar potential obtained from compactification stabilizes the metric except for one radial modulus, which is in agreement with what was found by other researchers.
we have constructed the most general three-dimensional N=1 supersymmetric theory coupled to a vector multiplet and matter multiplets in superspace.

we have constructed an N=1 superspace formulation of the most general causal three-dimensional action coupled to matter, which includes the N=1 supersymmetric extension of the Einstein–Hilbert–Maxwell action and the N=1 superconformal theory of three dimensions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the supersymmetric and gauge invariant actions in three dimensions, with particular focus on the compactification of M-theory on seven-dimensional manifolds with holonomy Spin(7).
the study of the most general causal action for three-dimensional supergravity.
the study of supersymmetric field theories and the construction of their most general actions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the three-dimensional N=1 theory obtained by compactifying on a Spin(8)/Spin(7) manifold with a non-zero four-form flux is in agreement with a three-dimensional N=2 theory obtained by dimensional reduction on a seven-dimensional N=1 superconformal theory with a non-vanishing gravitino superpotential.
M-theory compactifications on Spin(7)-manifolds with fluxes give rise to three-dimensional N=1 superconformal theories.
the three-dimensional theory is the most general causal, gauge invariant action that can be obtained by Kaluza– Klein compactification of M-theory on Spin (7) manifold.

the most general causal, N=1 supersymmetric three-dimensional, gauge theory coupled to matter is obtained by compactifying eleven-dimensional M-theory on Spin (7) holonomy manifolds.
